cohort: 399 premature neonates weighing 1250 grams or less
finding: There was no difference in the incidence of intraventricular hemorrhage or patent ductus arteriosus requiring surgery between infants who received prophylactic indomethacin and those who did not, but there was an increase in bronchopulmonary dysplasia in the group that received prophylactic indomethacin.
